story.paragraph: A woman with long dark hair talks on a pink mobile phone in a dimly lit room. The scene cuts to a woman with blonde hair and glasses, who is talking on a silver mobile phone with a worried expression. The conversation continues back and forth between them. Then, a young man with dark hair is shown holding the silver mobile phone to his ear in a room with curtains. The camera pulls back to reveal he is in a cluttered room with a red armchair, a drum set, and a clown mask on the wall. A young girl is sitting at a small wooden piano playing in the background. The blonde woman is shown again, looking sad while holding the phone. Finally, the young man is seen standing in the cluttered room, still on the phone, while the girl continues to play the piano.
story.summary: Two women have a concerned phone conversation, which connects to a young man in a cluttered room who is talking on the phone while a girl plays the piano nearby.
